name: agent-doc-drift-audit
description: Audit agent-facing repo docs (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .claude/, REPO_MAP, README, runbooks) across one or many repos for claims that contradict the code, then land the fixes as per-repo PRs. Use when: (1) asked to evaluate or clean up CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md across repos, or to design an org-level convention doc, (2) an agent acted on a doc claim that turned out false (a folded module, a retired fleet, a renamed test), (3) a migration finished and its status text was never re-derived. Ships scripts/check-doc-paths.py, a stdlib checker for stale paths, broken links and committed plugin stubs.
